spider_preview_prompt: Use case: ads-marketing / compositing. Create a crisp pixel-art combat storyboard illustration for a 1990s game strategy magazine about GLOBAL PLUMBING INITIATIVE. Input 1 is the official flying spider six-pose sprite design. Input 2 is actual basement gameplay with Sean. Preserve the spider's dark teal-black bristly body, red eyes, ivory fangs, white feathered angel wings, golden halo, eight legs. Sean is fully bald with a chin beard, orange shirt, blue overalls, red heavy plunger cannon. Make TWO wide 16:9 pixel-art encounter panels STACKED vertically with a thin dark separator. Upper panel: spider dive attack from upper right toward Sean at lower left; Sean backs away with plunger cannon pointing toward it. Lower panel: spider at near-contact range swooping just over Sean as he runs left and ducks his shoulders. Monster about Sean's height with wings twice his width. Keep side-view 2D game composition, copper pipes, brick walls, metal floor matching real gameplay input. Crisp chunky readable sprites. Use the reference player's likeness and outfit, no extra players, no other monsters. No gore. These are proposed encounter storyboard illustrations, not literal screenshots. Do not draw HUD, fake stats, text, labels, health bars, logos or window chrome. Keep all sprites inside frame; visually obvious attacking poses and readable spacing. Palette dark navy basement, copper pipes, orange uniform, white wings, pale mint platform highlights.
